name: Roanoke Street Apartments
text:
Fees and Deposits
Security Deposit, 1 month's rent; Application Fee, $35 per person; Nonrefundable Pet Registration Fee, $200; Pet Rent, $25/month

Pet Policy
- Non-refundable pet registration fee of $200
- Monthly pet fee of $25 per month

Floor Plans
Optional Washer and dryer, $60

The page lists no rent prices, parking fees, utility fees, or admin fees.
notes: 2-5 bedroom apartments 5 blocks from downtown. Fees listed, but no rent prices on any fetched page. Site also links a Policy & Procedures Handbook PDF (/images/documents/POLICY-AND-PROCEDURE-HANDBOOK-UPDATED-2026.pdf) that may hold more fees; not fetched.
